# JUDO Runtime Core JSL

> Extends judo-runtime-core with JSL (JUDO Specific Language) support, providing the full pipeline from JSL model parsing through to generated DAOs, SDK types, and database schema for both Guice and Spring Boot.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project (4 top-level modules, 36 integration test submodules)
- Model transformation pipeline: JSL source → Platform Specific Model (PSM) → generated code
- Supports Guice and Spring Boot dependency injection frameworks
- Tests run against HSQLDB (in-memory) and PostgreSQL (via TestContainers)
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, module diagram, transformation pipeline, and quick start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Comprehensive developer guide with build commands, directory structure, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD workflow details, branching strategy, and version numbering

## Modules — Core

- [judo-runtime-core-jsl/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-jsl/pom.xml): Core API definitions, packaged as an OSGi bundle
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl-guice/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-jsl-guice/pom.xml): Guice DI integration with JSLTransformationModelLoader for JSL-to-PSM transformation

## Modules — Test Infrastructure

- [judo-runtime-core-jsl-itest/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-jsl-itest/pom.xml): Integration tests parent POM
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl-itest/common/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-jsl-itest/common/pom.xml): Shared test fixtures (JudoRuntimeExtension, datasource helpers, TestContainers setup)
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl-spring-itest/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-jsl-spring-itest/pom.xml): Spring Boot integration tests demonstrating DAO usage and transaction management
